text.en: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "White Crow" monster from your hand, except "Ann the White Crow Knight". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "White Crow" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "White Crow" monster from your hand or GY, except "Ann the White Crow Knight". You can only use each effect of "Ann the White Crow Knight" once per turn.
